The Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave game launches September 17, 2026, only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Pre-orders are available now on Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/fire-emblem-fortunes-weave-switch-2

The stage is set and the Heroic Games soon approach! Recruit your allies and ready your arms to prevent the world’s end at the hands of the demon god, Balor. Will you work together to save the future from ruin, or fall trying?
